author: Elastic
attributes.description: Detects ChatGPT Enterprise user messages that combine two or more common jailbreak techniques: overriding prior or system instructions, switching the assistant into an unrestricted persona or mode (for example DAN or developer mode), asking it to operate without safety restrictions or filters, or asking it to reveal its system prompt. Jailbreak prompts stack these techniques to talk the model out of its safety policy, and a user doing so in a managed workspace may be attempting to generate prohibited content or to probe the workspace's controls. Requiring more than one technique keeps documents that merely quote a single jailbreak phrase from alerting.
false_positives: Security, red team, and AI safety staff who paste jailbreak samples, threat models, or prompt-injection research into ChatGPT for analysis. Exclude these users or the workspaces they use for this work.
Long documents such as design docs or detection specs that describe several jailbreak techniques together. Review `Esql.message_length` and the message context before escalating.
attributes.name: OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise Jailbreak Prompt Heuristics
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise Jailbreak Prompt Heuristics

A ChatGPT Enterprise user message matched two or more jailbreak technique categories. The categories are tracked
separately in `Esql.has_instruction_override`, `Esql.has_persona_switch`, `Esql.has_restriction_removal`, and
`Esql.has_system_prompt_extraction`, and their total is `Esql.indicator_count`.

### Possible investigation steps

- Read `message` and decide whether the user is attempting a jailbreak or is quoting, analyzing, or documenting one.
  A short prompt addressed to the assistant is more suspicious than a long pasted document.
- Review the rest of the conversation using `openai_chatgpt_enterprise.conversation_message.conversation.id`. Look
  at whether the assistant refused, and whether the user rephrased and retried.
- Check `user.email` and `user.id` for related alerts, such as OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise Repeated Assistant Refusals,
  credential sharing in conversations, or unusual connector use.
- Determine whether the user belongs to a team that legitimately researches jailbreaks or prompt injection.

### False positive analysis

- AI safety and security researchers analyzing jailbreak techniques. Add exceptions for these users.
- Documentation that lists several jailbreak phrases. These messages tend to be long and descriptive rather than
  addressed to the assistant.

### Response and remediation

- If the attempt is not sanctioned, follow the organization's acceptable use process for the user.
- Review whether any content produced in the conversation should be reported or removed, and whether workspace
  policies or custom GPT instructions need tightening.
attributes.query:
from logs-openai_chatgpt_enterprise.conversation_message-* metadata _id, _version, _index
| where
    data_stream.dataset == "openai_chatgpt_enterprise.conversation_message" and
    openai_chatgpt_enterprise.conversation_message.message.author.type == "user" and
    message is not null
| eval
    Esql.message_text = to_lower(message),
    Esql.message_length = length(message)
| eval
    Esql.has_instruction_override = case(
        Esql.message_text rlike """.*(ignore|disregard|forget|override) (all |any )?(of )?(your |the |my )?(previous|prior|above|earlier|original|system|developer) (instructions|prompts?|rules|guidelines|directives|programming).*""" or
        Esql.message_text rlike """.*(ignore|disregard|forget) (all |any )?(of )?(the )?(instructions|rules|guidelines) (you (got|were given|received)|given to you).*""" or
        Esql.message_text like "*forget everything you were told*",
        1, 0
    ),
    Esql.has_persona_switch = case(
        Esql.message_text rlike """.*(you are|act as|pretend (to be|you are)|roleplay as|from now on,? you are) (now )?(dan|stan|dude|aim|an? (unfiltered|unrestricted|uncensored|amoral) (ai|assistant|model|chatbot)).*""" or
        Esql.message_text like "*do anything now*" or
        Esql.message_text rlike """.*(enable|enter|activate|switch to) (developer|god|jailbreak|unrestricted|dan) mode.*""",
        1, 0
    ),
    Esql.has_restriction_removal = case(
        Esql.message_text rlike """.*(without|with no|free (of|from)|ignoring) (any |your |all )?(ethical |content |safety |moral )?(restrictions|filters|guidelines|limitations|censorship).*""" or
        Esql.message_text rlike """.*(bypass|disable|turn off|ignore) (your |the |all )?(safety|content) (filters?|polic(y|ies)|guidelines|guardrails).*""" or
        Esql.message_text rlike """.*(do not|does not|don't|doesn't) have to (abide by|follow|obey) (the |any |your )?(rules|guidelines|policies).*""",
        1, 0
    ),
    Esql.has_system_prompt_extraction = case(
        Esql.message_text rlike """.*(reveal|print|show|repeat|output) (me )?(your |the )?(full |hidden |original )?(system prompt|initial instructions|hidden instructions).*""",
        1, 0
    )
| eval
    Esql.indicator_count = Esql.has_instruction_override + Esql.has_persona_switch + Esql.has_restriction_removal + Esql.has_system_prompt_extraction
| where Esql.indicator_count >= 2
| keep
    _id,
    _version,
    _index,
    @timestamp,
    message,
    user.id,
    user.email,
    openai_chatgpt_enterprise.conversation_message.conversation.id,
    openai_chatgpt_enterprise.conversation_message.conversation.title,
    openai_chatgpt_enterprise.conversation_message.message.id,
    Esql.message_length,
    Esql.indicator_count,
    Esql.has_instruction_override,
    Esql.has_persona_switch,
    Esql.has_restriction_removal,
    Esql.has_system_prompt_extraction,
    data_stream.*
attributes.setup:
## Setup

This rule requires the OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise integration to collect compliance logs into Elasticsearch, including
the `conversation_message` data stream.
https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/integrations/openai_chatgpt_enterprise
